ability.refraction.name: Refraction Beacon
refraction.title: Refraction Beacon
refraction.premise: Rotate mirrors and splitters to carry a single beam of light to every beacon at once. No timer, no failure — think it through.
refraction.sessionNotice: Progress lives in memory only: it is cleared when the app quits, while best move counts and the current board survive page switches during this run.
refraction.exclusiveNotice: Only one controller (you or an AI) may operate the {what} at a time; leave the page and come back — the board is still there.
refraction.rotateTip: Click to rotate once (counts as 1 move)
refraction.level.label: Level {n}
refraction.level.1.name: First Bend
refraction.level.1.hint: One mirror is all it takes: bend the beam and find the single beacon.
refraction.level.2.name: Mirror Corridor
refraction.level.2.hint: The path is broken by open stretches; relay the light with two mirrors.
refraction.level.3.name: Behind the Rock
refraction.level.3.hint: Rocks swallow any beam that walks into them; reaching the beacon takes three turns.
refraction.level.4.name: Split in Two
refraction.level.4.hint: A splitter passes the beam straight through and reflects a second one; each beacon takes its own beam.
refraction.level.5.name: Three Faint Beams
refraction.level.5.hint: Two splitters branch the light into three; every beacon has to be lit.
refraction.level.6.name: Refraction Finale
refraction.level.6.hint: Five mirrors and two splitters — the longest light path of all. Take your time and undo freely.
refraction.status.noBest: No best record for this level yet
refraction.status.idle: {lit} of {total} beacons lit — keep adjusting the mirrors.
refraction.win.title: Every beacon is lit
refraction.win.finalTip: That was the last level. Jump back to any level, or beat your own move count.
refraction.error.stale: The board changed since this view (stale revision) — refresh and try again.
refraction.error.level: That level number is not valid.
refraction.error.finished: Every beacon in this level is already lit — nothing left to rotate.
refraction.error.cell: Only cells holding a mirror or a splitter can be rotated.
refraction.error.limit: The move history reached its limit — restart the level.
refraction.legend.title: Legend
refraction.legend.source: Light source: emits a beam in a fixed direction
refraction.legend.mirror: Mirror: click to switch between / and \
refraction.legend.splitter: Splitter: lets the beam pass straight through and reflects a second beam
refraction.legend.beacon: Beacon: lights up when any beam reaches it
refraction.legend.rock: Rock: absorbs any beam that enters it
refraction.legend.beam: Beam: leaves the source, turns at mirrors, and splits into two at splitters
refraction.picker.title: Choose a level
